_README: Mid-Iowa Auction seller terms used for the consign route. Fields marked verified=false are placeholders: replace with MIA's actual schedule before showing numbers to an operator.

commission.basis: rate for the hammer bracket applies to the whole hammer price
commission.source: midiowaauctioncompany.com/our-company.htm (search excerpt, 2026-10): 'When your items sell you are charged 3% to 6%. The higher the value, the lower the rate... no fees if the asset doesn't sell.' Bracket breakpoints are NOT published; these are placeholders.

settlement_days.source: Placeholder. Comparable houses: Purple Wave up to 15 business days, Ritchie Bros within 21 days.

days_to_next_sale.source: Placeholder: set from MIA's sale calendar.

seller_prep_cost.source: Placeholder: wash/detail/photos for a large unit.

seller_transport_cost.source: Online-auction buyers typically arrange pickup; set if MIA requires delivery to a yard.
